texts.bulletin: DANGEROUS HEAT STRESS — City of Tuguegarao: WBGT index in danger zone. SUSPEND all field work from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Ensure field workers rest in shade and drink water every 15 minutes. Monitor livestock — ensure shade, ventilation, and clean water for poultry/swine. Coordinate with RHU/BHS on heat-related illness protocols. Apply irrigation to vegetable crops early morning or late afternoon only.

texts.bulletin: DANGEROUS HEAT STRESS — Enrile: WBGT index in danger zone. SUSPEND all field work from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Ensure field workers rest in shade and drink water every 15 minutes. Monitor livestock — ensure shade, ventilation, and clean water for poultry/swine. Coordinate with RHU/BHS on heat-related illness protocols. Apply irrigation to vegetable crops early morning or late afternoon only.
texts.sms: DA HEAT ALERT: Dangerous heat in Enrile. NO farm work 9AM-4PM. Drink water. Protect livestock.
texts.lgu:
HEAT STRESS EMERGENCY — Enrile
WBGT index in dangerous range.
1. Issue public health advisory with RHU.
2. Restrict field labor 9AM–4PM.
3. Coordinate BAI for livestock heat stress monitoring.
4. Ensure water availability at farm sites.
texts.facebook:
🌡️ HEAT DANGER ALERT — Enrile

Mapanganib na init ngayon!
⛔ Huwag magtrabaho sa bukid mula 9AM–4PM
💧 Uminom ng maraming tubig
🐔 Bantayan ang mga hayop

#HeatStress #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER PESTICIDE / FOLIAR SPRAYING - Dinapigue: pesticide, fungicide, herbicide, and foliar application should be deferred. Basis: wind speed is high enough to increase spray drift risk. ACAP calendar anchor: Jul 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Reproductive; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Leaf development. Recommended action: reschedule spraying for a clear, low-wind window to avoid wash-off and drift.

texts.bulletin: DANGEROUS HEAT STRESS — Santa Maria: WBGT index in danger zone. SUSPEND all field work from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Ensure field workers rest in shade and drink water every 15 minutes. Monitor livestock — ensure shade, ventilation, and clean water for poultry/swine. Coordinate with RHU/BHS on heat-related illness protocols. Apply irrigation to vegetable crops early morning or late afternoon only.
texts.sms: DA HEAT ALERT: Dangerous heat in Santa Maria. NO farm work 9AM-4PM. Drink water. Protect livestock.
texts.lgu:
HEAT STRESS EMERGENCY — Santa Maria
WBGT index in dangerous range.
1. Issue public health advisory with RHU.
2. Restrict field labor 9AM–4PM.
3. Coordinate BAI for livestock heat stress monitoring.
4. Ensure water availability at farm sites.

🐔 Bantayan ang mga hayop

Rainfall of 21.5 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
